summary: The answer may be hiding in the one detail everyone keeps treating like it does not matter.
body: The answer may be hiding in the one detail everyone keeps treating like it does not matter. When Mercury trines Uranus, your mind spots patterns, errors, shortcuts, and alternatives faster than usual, making it easier to see a solution that was invisible under the old assumptions. Follow the odd detail. Test the unconventional fix. If one small insight removes the larger bottleneck, do not dismiss it because the solution looks too simple.
